strategic_themes.label: Financing lifecycle
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about obtaining, using, changing, and repaying business financing.

midlevel_themes.label: Application and decisions
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about submitting a financing application and receiving a decision.

specific_themes.label: Application requirements
specific_themes.definition: The documents, business history, and information required to apply.

specific_themes.label: Decision turnaround
specific_themes.definition: The time between submitting an application and receiving an approval or rejection.

specific_themes.label: Decision transparency
specific_themes.definition: How clearly an application status, outcome, and reasons for the decision are communicated.

midlevel_themes.label: Funding and invoices
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about processing financed invoices and receiving the resulting funds.

specific_themes.label: Payout timing
specific_themes.definition: The elapsed time between invoice approval or submission and payout.

specific_themes.label: Invoice administration
specific_themes.definition: Creating, changing, automating, or otherwise managing invoices in the financing service.

midlevel_themes.label: Product fit and flexibility
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about whether financing products fit the business and can adapt as its needs change.

specific_themes.label: Product suitability
specific_themes.definition: How well a financing or banking product fits the company's size, situation, and needs.

specific_themes.label: Credit line flexibility
specific_themes.definition: The ability to adjust, renew, or end a credit line without unnecessary reapplication or delay.

midlevel_themes.label: Repayment and collections
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about meeting payment obligations and how overdue cases are handled.

specific_themes.label: Repayment flexibility
specific_themes.definition: The availability of adapted repayment plans, payment deferrals, or seasonal arrangements.

specific_themes.label: Collections handling
specific_themes.definition: How the company communicates and acts before or during debt collection.

strategic_themes.label: Pricing and terms
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about fees, interest, and the contractual conditions attached to products.

midlevel_themes.label: Fees
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about the amount, number, and explanation of non-interest charges.

specific_themes.label: Fee level
specific_themes.definition: The overall amount or cumulative burden of fees charged.

specific_themes.label: Fee transparency
specific_themes.definition: How clearly individual fees, their purpose, and their inclusion in an offer are disclosed.

midlevel_themes.label: Interest rates
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about the price of borrowing and how interest is determined.

specific_themes.label: Interest rate level
specific_themes.definition: The competitiveness or affordability of the interest rate offered.

specific_themes.label: Interest calculation
specific_themes.definition: How clearly and accurately interest or effective rates are calculated and explained.

specific_themes.label: Rate change communication
specific_themes.definition: How interest-rate changes are announced and reflected in the product.

midlevel_themes.label: Contractual terms
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about understanding and relying on product agreements and conditions.

specific_themes.label: Terms clarity
specific_themes.definition: How easy the agreement, eligibility rules, and product conditions are to find and understand.

specific_themes.label: Term changes
specific_themes.definition: Changes to agreed product conditions and how those changes affect the customer.

strategic_themes.label: Service and communication
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about assistance from people or support channels and the reliability of information provided.

midlevel_themes.label: Support delivery
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about reaching support, receiving replies, and getting an issue carried through.

specific_themes.label: Response timeliness
specific_themes.definition: How quickly and reliably support responds across phone, email, chat, or messaging.

specific_themes.label: Follow-up and ownership
specific_themes.definition: Whether staff take responsibility, keep promises, and follow an issue through to completion.

specific_themes.label: Support channel navigation
specific_themes.definition: The ability to reach the right help, move beyond automated support, and avoid channel loops.

midlevel_themes.label: Advisor relationship
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about the competence, behaviour, and continuity of customer-facing staff.

specific_themes.label: Advisor expertise
specific_themes.definition: The advisor's knowledge of products, rules, and the customer's business situation.

specific_themes.label: Staff conduct
specific_themes.definition: How courteous, respectful, and constructive staff are when dealing with customers.

specific_themes.label: Relationship continuity
specific_themes.definition: The availability of a consistent contact person and continuity when staff change.

midlevel_themes.label: Information trust
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about whether company information and public signals are consistent and credible.

specific_themes.label: Cross-channel consistency
specific_themes.definition: Whether the portal, website, chatbot, email, and staff provide compatible information.

specific_themes.label: Institutional credibility
specific_themes.definition: Signals that affect trust in the company, including the perceived authenticity of public reviews.

strategic_themes.label: Digital experience and data
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about digital access, interfaces, integrations, reports, and the accuracy of displayed data.

midlevel_themes.label: Online portal
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about accessing and using the browser-based customer portal.

specific_themes.label: Portal access
specific_themes.definition: The ability to authenticate and log in to the portal reliably.

specific_themes.label: Portal usability
specific_themes.definition: How clear, modern, and easy the portal is to navigate.

specific_themes.label: Portal performance
specific_themes.definition: The speed, responsiveness, and technical stability of the portal.

midlevel_themes.label: Mobile banking
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about using the service from a dedicated mobile application.

specific_themes.label: Mobile app
specific_themes.definition: The availability and practical functionality of the mobile application.

midlevel_themes.label: External integrations
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about exchanging data with bookkeeping or accounting systems.

specific_themes.label: Accounting integration reliability
specific_themes.definition: How consistently and accurately accounting-system integrations exchange data.

midlevel_themes.label: Reporting and data
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about obtaining financial records and trusting the information shown.

specific_themes.label: Reporting and export access
specific_themes.definition: The availability, history, completeness, and exportability of statements and reports.

specific_themes.label: Financial data accuracy
specific_themes.definition: The correctness of balances, transactions, invoices, and other financial figures displayed.
